mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, card_holder_name, card_brand, last_four_digits, expiry_month, expiry_year, payment_token, is_default, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updated_at FROM payment_cards WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO payment_cards ( user_id, card_holder_name, card_brand, card_hash, last_four_digits, expiry_month, expiry_year, payment_token, is_default ) VALUES ( #{user_id}, #{card_holder_name}, #{card_brand}, #{card_hash}, #{last_four_digits}, #{expiry_month}, #{expiry_year}, #{payment_token}, IFNULL(#{is_default},0) )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE card_holder_name = VALUES(card_holder_name), payment_token = VALUES(payment_token), is_default = VALUES(is_default), updated_at = NOW()
